no_ads_desc: You can still watch ads for rewards
room10_d10_r1_loc: Arthur, you're a genius! Come here, let me hug you!
room10_d10_r2_loc: Come on, I didn’t do anything.
room10_d10_r3_loc: You were the smartest one at school. I even envied you!
room10_d10_r4_loc: And now... I would have given up already, but you were right!
room10_d10_r5_loc: The key wasn't Mom's name. Or mine. That would be too easy. It was my nickname!
room10_d10_r6_loc: I tried "Little Bird" as the cipher key, and suddenly the message meant something completely different.
room10_d10_r7_loc: I just need time to finish decoding it.
room10_d11_r1_loc: I hope you won't keep your dark secrets in this safe?
room10_d11_r2_loc: Oh, Henry. I've got a whole closet set aside for those.
room10_d11_r3_loc: Very funny. You were joking, right? Right?
room10_d12_r1_loc: All right, here's what the message says with the new cipher key:
room10_d12_r2_loc: "My dear Anya. I knew only you could solve my riddles."
room10_d12_r3_loc: "Forgive me for leading you in circles. I had to keep my gift safe."
room10_d12_r4_loc: "I've made a great discovery, one I've worked toward my whole life."
room10_d12_r5_loc: "The results of my work are hidden beneath our house. I've left clues for you."
room10_d12_r7_loc: Now we know where to look, we just need...
room10_d1_r1_loc: Just imagine. This man was a true genius...
room10_d1_r2_loc: Hello Arthur. Meet Kate, my friend.
room10_d1_r3_loc: Nice to meet you! You have great style. Clearly a refined gentleman.
room10_d1_r4_loc: Thank you, my lady. That's kind of you to say. Now, let's get to work.
room10_d1_r5_loc: I have studied Mr. Winters' notes. Haven't found anything yet that could help us.
room10_d1_r6_loc: But, Anya, your father was a brilliant engineer.
room10_d1_r7_loc: If he really left something valuable, the key to it is definitely somewhere among these machines.
room10_d1_r8_loc: I've found another code. Dad's been leading me to it all this time. I just need to read it...
room10_d2_r1_loc: Do you think this thing can fly?
room10_d2_r2_loc: Dad said it was more like just a model.
room10_d2_r3_loc: Ah... Well, yes, that's what I thought.
room10_d3_r1_loc: There are so many... gadgets here. Maybe one of them will lead us to the treasure?
room10_d3_r2_loc: It's possible, but it will take a lot of time to study each one.
room10_d4_r1_loc: There's so much stuff! We'll never find a clue in all this machinery!
room10_d4_r2_loc: Don't worry. We can handle it. You just need a systematic approach.
room10_d4_r3_loc: Look for things your father might have thought were important to you.
room10_d4_r4_loc: He wanted you to be the one to solve this mystery!
room10_d4_r5_loc: I don't know... I loved that bird. I was always trying to play with it, but he wouldn't let me.
room10_d4_r6_loc: Dad even gave me a nickname — "Little Bird".
room10_d4_r7_loc: That's sweet. I'll try taking it apart. You look for anything else like that.
room10_d5_r1_loc: What about this thing? It looks rather odd. And it has a combination lock.
room10_d5_r2_loc: Unfortunately, it won't be easy to open.
room10_d5_r3_loc: Try 3011. My birthday. Dad always used it.
room10_d5_r5_loc: There's a note here that says "Maria".
room10_d5_r6_loc: Mom... Could it really be that simple? Let me try decoding it.
room10_d6_r1_loc: "Congratulations! You must be clever to have solved my riddle, and I'm sorry to disappoint you."
room10_d6_r2_loc: "There's nothing valuable here. I just wanted to play at being a spy in my old age."
room10_d6_r3_loc: "Forgive my little prank, and say hello to my Little Bird. I love her."
room10_d6_r4_loc: It was all in vain! He was just playing a prank on us!
room10_d6_r6_loc: Yes... How am I supposed to restore this place in time? I just can't afford it...
room10_d7_r1_loc: What should I tell Alex now? I don't want Victor to take him.
room10_d7_r2_loc: And Claire... She was our family lawyer. My friend. How could she?
room10_d7_r3_loc: I'm sure Victor cheated on me with her. And now they want to take my boy!
room10_d7_r4_loc: Don't worry. I won't allow this to happen!
room10_d7_r5_loc: Me neither! We'll make this place shine so much that inspector will choke on his tie!
room10_d7_r6_loc: I'll help too! Without my advice, this place has no style at all!
room10_d7_r7_loc: With all due respect, please let's do it without your help for now...
room10_d8_r1_loc: What would I do without you all? Dad's study is coming back to life!
room10_d8_r2_loc: Still, I'm disappointed there wasn't a real mystery after all. I thought...
room10_d8_r4_loc: Don't you think this is all too simple?
room10_d8_r5_loc: He made all those complicated riddles, then just hid the key to the biggest one in a safe?
room10_d8_t6_loc: You're right. Maybe it's a false trail?
room10_d9_r1_loc: I was terrified I'd drop it. It's a work of art!
room1_d1_r2_loc: This doesn't feel like home at all, Mom! I don't like it here!
room1_d1_r3_loc: This place just needs a little tidying up.
room1_d1_r4_loc: Do you want to help me? Let's clean up the trash together.
room1_d2_r1_loc: Good job! It already looks cleaner!
room1_d2_r3_loc: So we're staying here... What about Dad?
room1_d2_r4_loc: Dad will be living on his own now. This is our new home!
room1_d2_r5_loc: But first, I need to earn enough to pay for all these repairs.
room1_d3_r1_loc: Who's making all that noise?! Here to steal other people's things again?!
room1_d3_r3_loc: Anya? Is that you? Well, I'll be! Did you bring your boy to see your old home?
room1_d3_r4_loc: We're just going through... a difficult patch. We came to stay here for a while.
room1_d3_r5_loc: Oh, Anya, you can't live in all this dust!
room1_d3_r6_loc: You can stay with me, just like old times. It'll be more fun together!
room1_d3_r7_loc: Thank you, Aunt Mary! I feel bad imposing, but you're probably right.
room1_d3_r8_loc: We should get this place sorted out so we don't impose on you for too long.
room1_d4_r1_loc: Mom, do we really have to stay with that old lady?
room1_d4_r2_loc: Aunt Mary is very kind. Her place is a little cramped, yes...
room1_d4_r3_loc: But things will get better soon. And we will have our own house!
room1_d4_r6_loc: There's just a little bit left.
room1_d5_r1_loc: Now that's much better. It still feels a little empty, though.
room1_d5_r3_loc: Ah! Who are you? You nearly scared me to death!
room1_d5_r4_loc: Oh, sorry, I'm used to speaking loudly. My name is Henry, I'm sort of... a handyman here.
room1_d5_r5_loc: I was helping an older lady with some repairs, and she asked me to drop by.
room1_d5_r6_loc: My name is Anna. Anna Winters. Yes, I need help too.
room1_d5_r7_loc: There's a lot to do. We need new furniture, and the walls and floor need repairs.
room1_d5_r9_loc: Click on the furniture and choose the option you like. I'll install everything.
room1_d6_r1_loc: Mom, we need to hurry... Who's that man?
room1_d6_r2_loc: This is Henry. He helps with repairs.
room1_d6_r4_loc: Hello... Anyway, Mom, Aunt Mary says we should hurry up. She has a surprise.
room1_d6_r5_loc: I'll go and look for something cool here.
room1_d6_r6_loc: You are my little explorer. Just be careful!
room1_d6_r9_loc: Let's finish up. I'm curious about this surprise!
room1_d7_r10_loc: Just don't tell anyone where we are.
room1_d7_r1_loc: Hello? Hi, Kate. It's been ages since we talked.
room1_d7_r2_loc: Hi, Anya. How are you? I heard you and Victor had a big fight.
room1_d7_r3_loc: Yes... I can't do this anymore, Kate. I can't stand it anymore!
room1_d7_r4_loc: He watched my every move, used our son to manipulate me, and... he cheated on me.
room1_d7_r6_loc: I don't know. He had lipstick on his collar...
room1_d7_r7_loc: This is the last straw, you know? I took Alex and went to my dad's estate.
room1_d7_r8_loc: That's awful. I've been telling you to leave him for ages. Hang in there, girl.
room1_d7_r9_loc: Thank you, Kate. I'm trying. Come when you have time.
room1_d8_r1_loc: You've been a big help, Henry. I can't imagine what I would do without you.
room1_d8_r2_loc: Don't mention it. It's my job.
room1_d8_r3_loc: Look how lovely it is now! Well done, you two. I've made you some pies.
room1_d8_r4_loc: My favorites! Just like when I was little...
room1_d8_r5_loc: You come over too, Henry. We'll all have a bite together.
room1_d8_r6_loc: Now that's an offer I can't refuse!
room2_d1_r1_loc: Well, how do you like the pies?
room2_d1_r2_loc: The best pies in the universe! Can you cook like this?
room2_d1_r3_loc: If I could, son, we would have already bought a palace.
room2_d1_r4_loc: But I can't, so we'll have to build a palace ourselves.
room2_d1_r5_loc: By the way, do you want to help with cleaning? This is the room where I grew up.
room2_d1_r6_loc: Oh, mom, I have a lot to do here... let's do it another time?
room2_d1_r7_loc: Haha, all right. Whatever you say, my busy little man.
room2_d1_r8_loc: It's almost exactly as I remember it. But something's not right!
room2_d2_r1_loc: Good morning. I came to help, as promised!
room2_d2_r2_loc: We had a good time, by the way... Wow, what a beautiful lady in the photo.
room2_d2_r3_loc: That's my mom. It's strange, though. This photo always used to sit on Dad's desk...
room2_d2_r4_loc: Very nice. You look so much like her.
room2_d2_r5_loc: Yes... It's a pity, I hardly remember her. I'll probably take the photo with me.
room2_d2_r7_loc: Hmm... Someone wrote "Find your first friend" on the back. I should ask Mary.
room2_d3_r1_loc: Aunt Mary, do you know who might have written this?
room2_d3_r2_loc: Let me see... Well now, that looks just like Mr. Winters' handwriting.
room2_d3_r3_loc: So he left this for me. Did he want me to talk to someone?
room2_d3_r6_loc: Excuse me, but who is this Arthur?
room2_d3_r7_loc: We were friends as kids. It doesn't matter.
room2_d4_r1_loc: It's Mr. Big Ears! My first toy. I thought he was lost.
room2_d4_r2_loc: First toy? Maybe even your first friend?
room2_d4_r3_loc: Exactly! And he has a strange seam on his back, I don’t remember that.
room2_d4_r4_loc: Let me take a careful look, dear.
room2_d5_r1_loc: I do wonder why anyone would abandon an estate like this.
room2_d5_r2_loc: Well... I grew up in this house. It was just me and Dad.
room2_d5_r3_loc: He loved me, and he was very protective.
room2_d5_r4_loc: When I got married, we had a serious fight. He didn't like Victor.
room2_d5_r5_loc: I left, and he was left here all alone. And then at some point he just... disappeared!
room2_d5_r6_loc: Victor didn’t take care of the estate and wanted to sell it, but I didn’t allow it.
room2_d5_r7_loc: Do you think it’s my fault that everything turned out this way?
room2_d5_r8_loc: I think you and your father were both right in your own way.
room2_d5_r9_loc: But now you have the opportunity to restore everything and find out what happened to your father.
room2_d6_r1_loc: Aunt Mary! So what about the bunny?
room2_d6_r2_loc: I found a little note. I think it's for you.
room2_d6_r3_loc: "A riddle for Anya: why do clocks tick?"
room2_d6_r5_loc: I wonder what he meant by this.
room2_d6_r6_loc: He loved riddles and puzzles, and often came up with them for me. Even now...
room2_d6_r7_loc: We need to check everything more carefully, I’m sure there are more messages!
room2_d7_r1_loc: Mom, Aunt Mary says you found a riddle from Grandpa!
room2_d7_r2_loc: Honey, it's just a dusty piece of paper. Nothing interesting.
room2_d7_r3_loc: Come on, Mom! Is it a secret code? Please let me see.
room2_d7_r4_loc: Alex, this is grown-up stuff, you don't need to think about it. Better go... play.
room2_d7_r5_loc: Play? We don't even have decent internet here!
room2_d7_r6_loc: It's terribly boring here, and you're just messing around with this old house!
room2_d8_r1_loc: Maybe you should tell the boy. There's nothing wrong with it, is there?
room2_d8_r2_loc: Oh... I don't know where this will lead. Maybe we'll find something... bad.
room2_d8_r3_loc: I don't want the child to get involved in this.
room2_d8_r4_loc: Do you think he might ruin something?
room2_d8_r7_loc: There was definitely something. Behind the wall, I think...
room2_d9_r1_loc: Now we're done. And no strange sounds.
room2_d9_r2_loc: Yes. You've been a huge help again. I just wish we'd found more clues.
room2_d9_r3_loc: And then there's Alex... I need to talk to him.
room2_d9_r4_loc: I think the boy needs something to keep him busy.
room2_d9_r5_loc: I would like to spend more time with him, but this renovation...
room2_d9_r6_loc: It just requires a special approach.
room2_dirty_toy_loc: Dusty plush bunny on the bed
room2_old_poster_loc: Faded music band poster on the wall
room3_d1_r2_loc: Listen, I didn't mean to upset you. It's just...
room3_d1_r3_loc: Yes, mom, everything is fine. Can you hear? There's someone here!
room3_d1_r4_loc: You're right! Could it be mice?
room3_d1_r5_loc: It doesn't look like it. Let me help you get there.
room3_d2_r1_loc: Ducky... She's still here, waiting for me after all this time.
room3_d3_r4_loc: Let's sort it all out and find out. Come on, mom, help!
room3_d4_r1_loc: Well done, Alex. This would've taken forever without you.
room3_d4_r2_loc: Mom, this isn't about cleaning! We need to find who's making noise there.
room3_d4_r4_loc: It sounds like someone's rustling around under the bathtub...
room3_d5_r4_loc: Come here, little one. Oh, you've got a collar.
room3_d5_r6_loc: It only has a name on it — Sherlock. That's unusual.
room3_d5_r8_loc: I'll finish cleaning while you look after the kitten. Then we'll decide what to do.
room3_d6_r1_loc: So that's who was making noise behind the wall.
room3_d6_r2_loc: Yes. Looks like the little fellow ran away from his owners and hid here.
room3_d6_r4_loc: Us, of course! We're the ones who found him!
room3_d7_r1_loc: Found any more messages from your father?
room3_d7_r2_loc: No. Alex and I were busy looking for this little fluffball.
room3_d7_r3_loc: And he seemed to enjoy helping.
room3_d7_r4_loc: I told you. You just have to find the right way to reach him.
room3_d7_r5_loc: I'm just not sure we'll be able to keep him.
room3_d7_r6_loc: We need to look for the owner.
room3_d8_r1_loc: Hello? Hi, Anya. Sorry, I've been so busy I haven't managed to visit.
room3_d8_r2_loc: How are things, girl? How's Alex doing?
room3_d8_r3_loc: It's... complicated. He's bored here. All his friends are back in the city.
room3_d8_r4_loc: And here it’s just me and the endless repairs.
room3_d8_r5_loc: But you know... Dad, it seems, left us some kind of secret.
room3_d8_r6_loc: Interesting... Please keep me posted. I'll try to come soon.
room3_d9_r1_loc: All done. You can finally take a bath.
room3_d9_r2_loc: Haha, you've saved the day again, Henry. You really can fix anything!
room3_d9_r3_loc: I'm surprised you weren't recruited by some repair company.
room3_d9_r4_loc: I've got used to being on my own. Ever since my wife and I split up.
room3_d9_r6_loc: We didn't get along too well. But that's all in the past.
room3_d9_r7_loc: Now I want to save some money and buy a cozy house in the area.
room3_d9_r8_loc: If we become neighbors, it will be just wonderful. You don't mind helping sometimes, do you?
room3_d9_r9_loc: Well, how can I refuse you?
room3_old_rubber_duck_loc: Old rubber duck at the bottom of the bathtub
room4_d10_r1_loc: I hope this one doesn't make so much noise.
room4_d10_r2_loc: Tell me about it... I remember waking up to that racket too.
room4_d10_r3_loc: Fridges were scary back in your day!
room4_d11_r3_loc: I'll feed him! I just need to get some milk from Aunt Mary.
room4_d11_r4_loc: Off you go, sweetheart. We're nearly done.
room4_d11_r5_loc: Good job, kid. We couldn't have done it without you!
room4_d11_r7_loc: So that was the way to get through to him...
room4_d12_r1_loc: Mom! Mom! Aunt Mary says she found Sherlock's owner.
room4_d12_r2_loc: It's her friend from the other end of the village. I don't want to give him to some old lady!
room4_d12_r3_loc: Honey, this is her cat. She's probably worried.
room4_d12_r4_loc: But he ran away! He came to us! He's happier here!
room4_d12_r5_loc: I'll take care of him and give him milk... Please, can't we keep him?
room4_d12_r7_loc: No, Alex. I'm sorry, but we can't. He's not our cat, and we're not going to steal him.
room4_d12_r8_loc: You always decide everything for everyone! I'm not a little kid anymore, but you still won't listen!
room4_d1_r1_loc: I'd better finish cleaning before Kate arrives. Or anyone else...
room4_d2_r1_loc: The stove looks just like it did after my first attempt at cooking.
room4_d2_r2_loc: Dad fixed it back then... This time we'll have to throw it out.
room4_d3_r2_loc: Oh, hello, little one. Come to help?
room4_d3_r4_loc: Come on, Sherlock. Look for anything that dad might have left behind.
room4_d3_r6_loc: Just don't fall off the table, detective!
room4_d5_r11_loc: Mom, look who was meowing outside the window!
room4_d5_r1_loc: Sherlock! So you went for a stroll. I thought we'd lost you.
room4_d5_r2_loc: Good thing he didn't get past the fence. What are you doing?
room4_d5_r3_loc: Trying to get this kitchen fit for cooking again.
room4_d5_r4_loc: Oh, then you can make pies like Aunt Mary?
room4_d5_r5_loc: Mine won't be that good... But I'll try to learn.
room4_d5_r6_loc: Let me help! The sooner we finish, the sooner you can learn!
room4_d6_r3_loc: I just remembered how loudly this thing used to switch on at night.
room4_d6_r4_loc: Really? Our fridge never did that, did it?
room4_d6_r5_loc: Thank goodness! Let's get this one out of here.
room4_d7_r1_loc: Look how clean it is! Good job helping your mom, Alex. You're a real little man!
room4_d7_r3_loc: Just Henry! Maybe you can help with the repairs? I'll show you, it's not difficult.
room4_d7_r4_loc: Well, I could try. You watch too, Sherlock. Then you can help next time!
room4_d8_r3_loc: I think I've got a splinter. It hurts!
room4_d8_r4_loc: Oh, sweetheart. Let me help. Are you sure you wouldn't rather go out and play?
room4_d8_r5_loc: Thank you, mom. No, I also want to be useful.
room4_d8_r6_loc: What example will I set for Sherlock?
room4_d8_r7_loc: Haha, that's my boy. I'll put a bandage on it, and you can keep helping. Just be careful.
room4_d8_r8_loc: Let me show you how to do it without getting splinters.
room4_d9_r1_loc: Mom... There's something I should tell you. Dad called while you were cleaning the bedroom.
room4_d9_r3_loc: He asked how things were going here with you. I said it was a bit boring.
room4_d9_r4_loc: He was going to come, but I don’t want you to fight again!
room4_d9_r5_loc: He's coming? Here?! How does he know?!
room4_d9_r6_loc: I didn't tell him where we were. He doesn't know.
room4_d9_r7_loc: Phew... If he calls again, please give me the phone.
room4_d9_r8_loc: Mom, I'm not a little kid anymore. I can handle it.
room4_old_dish_cabinet_loc: A rickety cabinet with broken dishes
room4_old_dish_shelf_loc: Old cabinet with dishes on the right
room4_utensil_set_loc: Set of kitchen utensils above the stove
room5_d1_r3_loc: I can't find Alex! He's been gone all morning. And Sherlock too.
room5_d1_r4_loc: I wanted to clear out the attic. Dad's things must be here somewhere. And now this...
room5_d1_r5_loc: Also, I'm afraid it could be Victor. What if he found us?
room5_d1_r6_loc: Here's what we'll do. You take a breath and keep cleaning. I'll find him. I know this area well.
room5_d2_r2_loc: Dad's notebook! I knew he left something here!
room5_d2_r3_loc: I don’t understand anything... It’s just a bunch of letters.
room5_d2_r4_loc: Except right at the end: "For Anya".
room5_d2_r5_loc: "My dear Anya, I love you, but I have to go away. Far away, for a long time. Don't look for me if I don't return."
room5_d2_r6_loc: Then it's back to jumbled letters... And there are some little metal pieces here too.
room5_d3_r3_loc: My friend called. Your boy is at her place, playing with her granddaughter.
room5_d3_r4_loc: Oh, thank goodness! I was so worried...
room5_d3_r5_loc: Wait, that's not all. She says she saw an expensive black car here.
room5_d3_r6_loc: We've never had cars like that around here.
room5_d3_r7_loc: Do you think it could be someone dangerous?
room5_d3_r8_loc: I don't know, Anya. But it’s better to stay here for now, Henry will bring Alex.
room5_d4_r10_loc: Don't go anywhere yet. I need to finish, there seem to be more clues here!
room5_d4_r2_loc: Alex! Well, where have you been, son?
room5_d4_r3_loc: I was just... you know. Out for a walk.
room5_d4_r4_loc: Honey, don't scare me like that again, okay?
room5_d4_r5_loc: Okay. Sorry, mom. But I arranged for Sherlock to stay with us!
room5_d4_r7_loc: His owner turns out to be a lovely girl from next door. Alex even picked her some flowers.
room5_d4_r8_loc: Henry! That was just to help things along!
room5_d5_r1_loc: Where is it... Here! My favorite childhood book.
room5_d5_r3_loc: Yes! I want to keep it as a memento. Oh! What just fell out?
room5_d5_r4_loc: Some sort of card with holes in it.
room5_d5_r5_loc: It's a punch card. They used to store computer programs on these.
room5_d5_r6_loc: Dad was not a programmer... We need to check what's on it.
room5_d5_r7_loc: If we can find a fifty-year-old computer, we can take a look...
room5_d6_r10_loc: Okay. But if Alex doesn't want to talk to you, you get out of here immediately!
room5_d6_r1_loc: Well hello, dear. Did you miss me?
room5_d6_r2_loc: Victor? How did you... What are you doing here?
room5_d6_r3_loc: I came to pick up my son, of course. It's not good to separate him from his beloved dad.
room5_d6_r4_loc: I thought we'd settled this, Victor. You keep everything, but you leave me and Alex alone!
room5_d6_r5_loc: I'm afraid the situation has changed a little. I want to see Alex, and you have no right to interfere with me.
room5_d6_r6_loc: I have every right! I'm his...
room5_d6_r7_loc: Anna, stay calm. Let's get back to work. I'll get Alex, and he can speak for himself. Please, trust me.
room5_d6_r9_loc: That's right, listen to your handyman. Or things will get ugly!
room5_d7_r1_loc: How long do I still have to wait? I'm tired of breathing dust. I hate this place.
room5_d7_r3_loc: Finally! I've come to get you, just like I promised. Come on, I'll take you for a spin.
room5_d7_r6_loc: Dad... I don't want to leave. I'll stay here with mom!
room5_d7_r7_loc: What? You said it was boring here. And your whole life remained there: friends, toys, console.
room5_d7_r8_loc: Yeah, Dad. But Mom is here, and she means more to me than all that! Besides, I like it here!
room5_d8_r10_loc: This is outrageous! What are you saying? Who's been filling my boy's head with nonsense? You and your...
room5_d8_r11_loc: I think you'd better leave, mister. Keep bothering Anna, and I'll have to make you.
room5_d8_r12_loc: Okay. But I’ll come back, and we’ll talk completely differently, big guy.
room5_d9_r1_loc: How cozy it is here now! Just like home, even better.
room5_d9_r2_loc: Son... I'm glad you didn't go with him... I was very afraid...
room5_d9_r3_loc: Mom, where would I go without you? Or Sherlock and... my new friends... It's not so bad here, actually.
room5_d9_r4_loc: Just you wait. We'll teach you to saw and plane wood! Then you'll never get bored.
room5_d9_r5_loc: Oh, I almost forgot. Could this card help us read Dad's notebook?
room5_d9_r6_loc: It's just like in spy movies! Lay the card over the page, and the holes pick out the right letters.
room5_d9_r8_loc: “I will leave something very valuable for you in our house, Anya. I hope it will help in difficult times. Forgive me for everything. Dad.”
room5_d9_r9_loc: It looks like there are still many secrets in this house...
room6_d10_r1_loc: Finally... It was hard and I couldn't have done it without you guys!
room6_d10_r2_loc: I don't know how to thank you for all this, Henry. It's better here than it was!
room6_d10_r3_loc: Now guys, you can play here with Sherlock.
room6_d10_r4_loc: Hey, you in the tree! Some people are here asking for Anya!
room6_d10_r6_loc: I'm not sure what's going on, but I think we'd better call Arthur.
room6_d10_r7_loc: Absolutely not. I can handle this myself!
room6_d1_r1_loc: Honey, I'm so glad you stayed. I want to show you something interesting.
room6_d1_r2_loc: A treehouse? You said I wasn't allowed up here! It's too high!
room6_d1_r3_loc: You know, when I was little, a... friend and I used this as our hideout.
room6_d1_r4_loc: I thought you might like a hideout of your own. We just need to clean it up.
room6_d2_r3_loc: Oh, no! I just wanted to tell you my friend called. Her granddaughter is coming to visit.
room6_d2_r4_loc: How lovely. You'll be able to show her your hideout.
room6_d2_r5_loc: But there's nothing here! Only dust and dirt.
room6_d2_r6_loc: Don't worry, we'll make it before she arrives!
room6_d3_r1_loc: What a cool telescope. Dad promised to buy one, but never bought it...
room6_d3_r2_loc: Don't worry, we'll fix it and put it here.
room6_d3_r3_loc: Dad used to show me the stars. He said there was someone out there...
room6_d3_r4_loc: Oh, what is this? Son, take a look.
room6_d3_r5_loc: Someone's damaged it. Scratched the... what's it called? The lens.
room6_d3_r6_loc: Someone scratched a clock face into it. How strange. Another message from Dad?
room6_d4_r2_loc: Sherlock! How did you get here? Do you want to help?
room6_d4_r3_loc: Maybe you can find something from grandpa?
room6_d4_r5_loc: Let's hope we don't end up searching for our little detective again.
room6_d4_r6_loc: Please look after him, there is not much left here.
room6_d5_r1_loc: Hello everyone! Wow, and Sherlock is here.
room6_d5_r3_loc: Well, it's time to decorate this house!
room6_d5_r4_loc: Thank you Uncle Henry! Just hurry up, please, I'm waiting for guests!
room6_d5_r5_loc: Climbing up here is quite an adventure. But I'll do my best to bring up everything we need.
room6_d5_r6_loc: Just be careful, it's really high up here!
room6_d6_r3_loc: Mom, we won't make it in time! Alice will be here soon!
room6_d6_r4_loc: Honey, I understand, but it's very difficult for Henry to carry all this here.
room6_d6_r5_loc: Don’t worry, Anya, I can handle it! I'll take a break and get back to work.
room6_d7_r1_loc: Hello everyone! Hi Alex, hi Alex's mom, hi Henry!
room6_d7_r3_loc: And I got up early and already managed to pick mushrooms and berries.
room6_d7_r5_loc: Thanks! We haven't quite finished getting everything ready, though.
room6_d7_r6_loc: Uncle Henry found it very difficult to work at heights.
room6_d8_r1_loc: How's it going? Everything is fine, I hope?
room6_d8_r2_loc: Don't worry, Anya. I'm hauling up the rope, and the kids are keeping me steady.
room6_d8_r3_loc: Alice is also great at tying knots. At least now I definitely won’t fall.
room6_d8_r4_loc: Wonderful! I'm glad they help you so much!
room6_d8_r5_loc: I agree. Still, let's get this over with quickly.
room6_d9_r2_loc: Oh Sherlock, I forgot you were here.
room6_d9_r3_loc: There's my little darling! Come here!
room6_d9_r5_loc: So this is where you keep sneaking off to! You're more of a Moriarty than a Sherlock.
room6_d9_r6_loc: He's just looking for clues. Helps me and my mom with the investigation!
room6_d9_r7_loc: How interesting! What kind of investigation?
room6_d9_r8_loc: Honey, let's not talk about this for now...
room7_d1_r1_loc: How much longer are we supposed to wait? So irresponsible!
room7_d1_r2_loc: I agree, Mr. Miller, and how can such a person raise a child?
room7_d1_r3_loc: Good afternoon! Sorry about the mess. We're renovating...
room7_d1_r4_loc: I can see that. Thomas Miller, child welfare services. Your husband informed us...
room7_d1_r5_loc: Oh, I can imagine what that liar told you!
room7_d1_r6_loc: Nevertheless, the information seems quite accurate.
room7_d1_r7_loc: Miss Morgan says the house is in a dreadful state. From what I can see, she's right.
room7_d1_r8_loc: Oh, no! It just needs a little tidying up!
room7_d2_r2_loc: Here comes young Mr. Winters. You and I have a lot to discuss.
room7_d2_r3_loc: You want to take me away from my mother, right?
room7_d2_r4_loc: I'm here to assess your living conditions. So far, I'm very concerned.
room7_d2_r5_loc: Don't even think about taking Alex! We're doing great!
room7_d2_r6_loc: We're helping Alex's mom fix things up. It'll be even better soon!
room7_d3_r1_loc: Alex, you used to love video games and hanging out with your friends. What are you doing?
room7_d3_r2_loc: Anna, what kind of child labor is this?
room7_d3_r3_loc: Now, Miss Morgan, children need to learn to keep things tidy.
room7_d3_r4_loc: That's what we teach in the... institutions I represent.
room7_d3_r5_loc: I hope it doesn't come to that.
room7_d4_r1_loc: That's much better now, isn't it?
room7_d4_r2_loc: Indeed. But the conditions are still concerning.
room7_d4_r4_loc: Don't worry, we'll have this place... what's the word? Spruced up in no time!
room7_d4_r6_loc: Henry. I'm Anna's friend. And I'm responsible for making this place shine again!
room7_d5_r1_loc: I didn't expect Victor to send you, Claire. I thought we got along.
room7_d5_r2_loc: And I didn't expect you to do something like this, Anya.
room7_d5_r3_loc: Have you thought about how Alex feels? His whole life is back there!
room7_d5_r4_loc: You don't understand! Victor's been filling your head with lies too!
room7_d5_r6_loc: Control yourself, Mrs. Winters, or I'll have to take action.
room7_d6_r1_loc: How long do I have to watch this circus? It seems that everything is quite clear here...
room7_d6_r2_loc: Hello, hello. Mrs. Wallace. I'm this lovely family's neighbor.
room7_d6_r3_loc: You're from child welfare services, I take it? I'm so glad you've finally arrived!
room7_d6_r5_loc: You know, Victor came not long ago. He shouted so much at poor Anya!
room7_d6_r6_loc: An awful man. I told her father he should never let her go off with him!
room7_d6_r7_loc: That's interesting. I've heard a very different account.
room7_d6_r8_loc: Come with me. I'll tell you all about that scoundrel.
room7_d6_r9_loc: In the meantime, the guys will finish the repairs.
room7_d7_r1_loc: Well, take a look at the transformation!
room7_d7_r2_loc: It's beautiful, Mom! I'm glad I could help!
room7_d7_r4_loc: Indeed, it looks quite decent. And you did it quickly.
room7_d7_r5_loc: I'm afraid I must be going. We'll need to look into the situation more closely.
room7_d7_r6_loc: We'll come back in a few days with a full inspection team.
room7_d7_r7_loc: If the house has not been restored by the time we arrive... You understand.
room7_old_hanging_basket_left_loc: Old hanging basket on the left
room7_old_hanging_basket_right_loc: old hanging basket on the right
room8_d1_r1_loc: What horror! It turns out that if you don’t fix everything here, they’ll take you away?
room8_d1_r2_loc: I don’t know... Maybe they’ll send me to dad. But I don't want to!
room8_d1_r3_loc: No one will take anyone away! We will handle everything, I promised!
room8_d1_r4_loc: Very good mood, Anya. I'll try to help too.
room8_d1_r5_loc: Aunt Mary, you've already been a big help. You cleverly distracted them then!
room8_d2_r1_loc: Anya! Hello, long time no see!
room8_d2_r2_loc: Arthur? What are you doing here? It was Mary who called you, right?
room8_d2_r3_loc: Is that any way to greet an old friend? I hear you could use an experienced lawyer.
room8_d2_r4_loc: No... more precisely... Yes. But I don't want...
room8_d2_r5_loc: Let me finish cleaning, okay? We need to hurry here.
room8_d3_r1_loc: Mom, we're done in the garden, maybe... Oh, who is this?
room8_d3_r3_loc: Friend. And now her lawyer too. You must be Alex. And this young lady...
room8_d3_r4_loc: Alice! Nice to meet you! And Alex too, right, Alex?
room8_d3_r6_loc: And you and your mother have a lot in common. Are you here to help with the cleaning?
room8_d3_r7_loc: No, they still need to clear out the shed. I'll manage here somehow.
room8_d3_r8_loc: Then perhaps I can help. We're running short on time, after all.
room8_d4_r1_loc: Well, there goes my $2,000 jacket. Covered in dust and cobwebs...
room8_d4_r2_loc: You didn't think it was that easy, did you?
room8_d4_r3_loc: Yeah, I haven’t picked up a mop for a long time.
room8_d5_r1_loc: Look how clean it is! Nice work, Anya. Oh, we've got company.
room8_d5_r2_loc: Meet Arthur, a lawyer. Aunt Mary called him to help with a custody issue.
room8_d5_r3_loc: Henry. Nice to meet you. Judging by the state of you, you're doing more than legal work?
room8_d5_r4_loc: Likewise. I'm doing what I can, though it hasn't quite gone to plan.
room8_d5_r5_loc: I take it you are doing renovations? Well, we should hurry, given the situation.
room8_d5_r6_loc: Hmm... Since you've already started, how about giving me a hand? We need to carry the furniture upstairs.
room8_d5_r7_loc: Then we will definitely be on time.
room8_d6_r1_loc: Ow! That landed on my foot!
room8_d6_r3_loc: Everything is fine, just a scratch, it seems...
room8_d6_r4_loc: You should've said it was too heavy, mister.
room8_d6_r5_loc: No, no, it's not heavy at all. I'm just out of practice. Let me catch my breath, then we'll carry on.
room8_d7_r1_loc: Strange. I visited you many times as a child, but I don’t remember this room.
room8_d7_r2_loc: This was Mom and Dad's bedroom. We had no reason to come in here.
room8_d7_r3_loc: True. It was more fun running around outside. And playing in that treehouse.
room8_d7_r4_loc: Remember? I was the knight, and you were the princess. I climbed up to you on a rope made of bedsheets.
room8_d7_r5_loc: And then you came tumbling down because you had that heavy saucepan on your head!
room8_d7_r6_loc: Yes... It was a wonderful time. It's a pity that everything is like this...
room8_d7_r7_loc: All right, everyone. We'd better keep going if we want to finish in time!
room8_d8_r10_loc: Mmm... Okay. I'll try as quickly as possible.
room8_d8_r1_loc: Hello? Kate? Is everything all right?
room8_d8_r2_loc: Of course, girl. I just wanted to say I've finally managed to get away and visit!
room8_d8_r3_loc: Great! We may need your help.
room8_d8_r5_loc: Victor. He called child welfare services and wants to take Alex! We need to get this place sorted out, fast.
room8_d8_r7_loc: Tell me about it. And I think I've figured out who he was cheating on me with!
room8_d8_r9_loc: I'll tell you when you get here. Now isn't a good time.
room8_d9_r1_loc: There you go. Now you can sleep here peacefully.
room8_d9_r2_loc: Oh... I don't even know. This was their room, and now I will be here...
room8_d9_r3_loc: But I can't stay with Aunt Mary forever, either.
room8_d9_r4_loc: Thanks for your help, Arthur. I know it was hard work, but we'd still be at it without you.
room8_d9_r5_loc: Don't mention it. Besides, the real work is still ahead of us.
room8_d9_r6_loc: Come on, tell me more about your family problems.
room8_d9_r7_loc: We need to work out our defense.
room8_d9_r8_loc: Well, that's where my expertise runs out...
room8_old_bedside_lamp_left_loc: Old bedside lamp on the left
room8_old_bedside_lamp_right_loc: old bedside lamp on the right
room9_d10_r1_loc: Awful. I don't understand that choice at all.
room9_d11_r1_loc: Already better. I think it's worth moving in this direction.
room9_d12_r1_loc: There seems to be a lack of shades of blue.
room9_d13_r1_loc: Awful! Good thing someone here has an eye for beauty!
room9_d16_r1_loc: There! The room looks much nicer with my advice, doesn't it? Don't you agree?
room9_d16_r2_loc: Well... Yes, I guess. Thank you, Kate.
room9_d16_r3_loc: Honestly, I'm not so sure. I prefer Anna's choices.
room9_d16_r4_loc: Oh, you just don't understand design, Henry.
room9_d16_r5_loc: Let's continue. Let's turn this place into something worthwhile.
room9_d17_r1_loc: Sometimes you do a really good job.
room9_d18_r2_loc: Art demands sacrifice. At least everything looks decent now!
room9_d18_r3_loc: I hope so. It's a shame I still haven't figured out Dad's letter.
room9_d18_r4_loc: It's our code, Dad's and mine. But I need a keyword to crack it. And it's nowhere to be found.
room9_d18_r5_loc: Maybe we could take a look in Mr. Winters' study.
room9_d18_r6_loc: That lawyer is lounging around in there. Maybe he's found something.
room9_d1_r1_loc: Aunt Mary, I am very grateful that you finally called Arthur.
room9_d1_r2_loc: He is not offended and is ready to help. Although I am very ashamed that everything turned out this way.
room9_d1_r3_loc: Don't worry, Anya. Everything will be fine. And there is still time to renovate the house.
room9_d1_r4_loc: You're right. But I'm afraid that Victor won't give up so easily.
room9_d1_r5_loc: Yes, and financially it’s very difficult to pull it all off.
room9_d1_r6_loc: I have to find what dad wrote about! This is our chance.
room9_d2_r2_loc: I'm trying to put things in order. And find something your grandfather might have left behind.
room9_d2_r4_loc: Alice is afraid that they will take me away and we will no longer be able to be friends. And I'm afraid of this too.
room9_d2_r5_loc: Honey, we won't give you away. Arthur promised to help.
room9_d2_r6_loc: He's good! Mom, you were friends when you were kids, right? Did something happen? Did you have a fight?
room9_d2_r7_loc: Yes, we spent a lot of time together. But then... Then we just grew up.
room9_d2_r8_loc: If you want, we can sort everything out here together. I feel like there's something here!
room9_d3_r2_loc: Dad taught me how to take it apart. Right. Unscrew this, press here...
room9_d3_r3_loc: The hands look just like the markings on the telescope lens...
room9_d3_r4_loc: Got it! It's open! There's something inside the mechanism...
room9_d3_r6_loc: This is a note from your grandfather, Alex.
room9_d3_r7_loc: True, it is encrypted as usual.
room9_d4_r4_loc: Alex... And I brought you a gift. Here you go.
room9_d4_r5_loc: What is this, a skateboard? Wow!
room9_d4_r6_loc: You've been wanting it for a long time, I think. And there is plenty of space to ride. How are you doing, Anya?
room9_d4_r7_loc: Actually, I didn't allow him to buy this thing... Oh well. Nice to see you!
room9_d4_r8_loc: We're in a bit of a rush, though. Let me finish, and then we can catch up.
room9_d5_r1_loc: Hello Anya. Are we having guests again?
room9_d5_r2_loc: Yes, Henry, meet Kate, my friend.
room9_d5_r3_loc: Wow, what a big boy. Your new... friend?
room9_d5_r4_loc: Well... He's helping with the renovations.
room9_d5_r5_loc: I see, I see. Well, if Henry takes care of the furniture, we can finally have a proper chat.
room9_d5_r6_loc: So, what's that piece of paper you've got?
room9_d5_r7_loc: Oh, I completely forgot. This is from dad!
room9_d5_r8_loc: Go ahead and chat, ladies. I'll get this done as quickly as I can.
room9_d6_r1_loc: So that's how things stand. I never imagined it would turn out like this.
room9_d6_r2_loc: I thought we decided everything that night. But he wanted to take Alex away!
room9_d6_r3_loc: You poor thing. Don't worry, we'll work it out together. By the way, you mentioned he was cheating on you...
room9_d6_r4_loc: That doesn't matter now. The important thing is showing child welfare services that Alex has a good home.
room9_d6_r6_loc: Well, this room looks pretty shabby. I wouldn't leave my child here.
room9_d6_r7_loc: But don't worry, I'll help. I have excellent taste.
room9_d7_r1_loc: Well, I don’t know... I would choose a different color.
room9_d8_r1_loc: Mmm... I like this, it's cute.
room9_d9_r1_loc: Very questionable style. Doesn't match the wallpaper at all.
